The animal with distinctive black and white stripes is the zebra.

Semantic Role Labeling for the sentence: "The programmer wrote the code that automated the entire process."

Main Verb: wrote

- The programmer: Agent (the doer of the action)
- wrote: Predicate (the main action)
- the code: Patient/Theme (the entity undergoing the action)
- that automated the entire process: Modifier/Relative Clause (providing more information about "the code")
  - that: Subject of the relative clause (referring to "the code")
  - automated: Predicate of the relative clause
  - the entire process: Patient/Theme of the relative clause
